remarks: Step into modern comfort with this immaculate 4-bedroom, 2-full-bath home, meticulously updated from top to bottom. Featuring new carpeting, a beautifully upgraded kitchen, and two renovated baths, this home offers both style and convenience. Highlights include a fenced yard perfect for a playscape, privacy, and pets. Fully Renovated in 1997 you will enjoy peace of mind knowing this home has been thoughtfully updated over the years, including new electrical and added insulation for energy efficiency. 1-Car Garage and large backyard with terrace, ideal for outdoor gatherings or quiet mornings. With a convenient first-floor bedroom, close proximity to shopping and transportation, this home offers everything you need.
